purpose: Current Survey routing defaults and method-specific interpretation; capabilities and source metadata live in the algorithm registry, actual run choices in manifests.

p3mix.prior_semantics: No external prior; class_prior is validated but does not affect training.
notes: Benchmark adaptation with base/e/c variants and role_balanced or merged_shuffle batching.
Native OS objective; no OS-to-TS loss-role replacement hook.

holistic_pu.prior_semantics: No external prior; pseudo-label estimates come from U predictions.
notes: Native OS follows the released standard split that excludes labeled positives from U.
The released long-tail branch is a distinct data recipe.

genpu.prior_semantics: population pi weights the mixture/discriminator objective and synthetic PN risk.
notes: Dense pixel generator with independent CNN discriminators is a project recipe.
The paper assumes marginal U; the released MNIST demo excludes labeled positives from U.
Upstream license is unresolved; the project does not copy or execute author source.

pulns.prior_semantics: No external prior; requires separately budgeted clean support labels.
notes: Requires clean support labels; PA+clean-support is separate from pure PU PA.
Paper P/U sampling is TS; the support adapter uses explicit OS and has no calibration hook.

pan.prior_semantics: No external prior in the objective; fit validates but ignores class_prior.
notes: Native OS follows the paper's single-training-set assumption.
Paper objective and released margin/overlap implementation differ; no numerical reproduction claim.

rp.prior_semantics: Estimates missing-positive noise rho1 and pi from out-of-fold predictions.
notes: SCAR missing-positive noise uses rho0=0, held-out crossfits and one weighted refit.
Degenerate inferred priors remain diagnostics rather than clipped valid priors.

upu.prior_semantics: population pi is required by the PU risk objective.
notes: The implemented variant uses a fixed squared-loss closed form and project basis/intercept defaults.

kldce.prior_semantics: Estimates its own prior via h: p=k/[n(1-h)]; no external class_prior.
notes: Frozen low-c settings can be mathematically infeasible; failures and numerical risks remain excluded.
Chunked kernel/QP execution changes memory use, not feasibility or numerical acceptance.

dist_pu.prior_semantics: population pi is the distribution-alignment target in both risk views.
notes: Default clean-room variant and opt-in author_staged recipe are distinct.
author_staged has two stages, persistent pseudo labels and a stage scheduler; it does not replay author test-based selection, architecture or preprocessing.

pusb.prior_semantics: No external prior; linear baseline fit ignores class_prior.
notes: Linear sklearn logistic-regression baseline; distinct from the kernel implementation and without a calibration hook.

pusb_kernel.prior_semantics: population pi is required by the kernel PU objective and quantile threshold.
notes: Official-aligned RBF kernel variant; source identity does not establish numerical reproduction.

lbe_neural.prior_semantics: No external prior; fit validates but ignores class_prior in the neural EM recipe.
notes: Explicit double-MLP 100/tanh EM variant, distinct from linear LBE.
Native OS joint likelihood has no TS calibration hook; fitted prior is output only.

lbe.prior_semantics: Optional class_prior initializes the latent U posterior; it is not a fixed objective prior.
notes: Linear observed-label joint-likelihood model; native OS with no TS calibration hook.
Toolbox warm-start behavior differs from the released MATLAB MStep overwriting Theta.

nnpu.prior_semantics: population pi is required by the non-negative PU risk objective.
notes: Mini-batch TS calibration appends P to the unlabeled loss pool while preserving its positive-loss role.

self_pu.prior_semantics: population pi weights the PU risk; TS loss-pool weighting retains pi.
notes: Default no-meta ablation and full-meta clean-support variant are separate supervision regimes.
Full-meta uses an OS adapter, all-epoch dual-teacher trajectories and separately budgeted clean support.
Distillation over untrusted_u and paper_population are explicit variants.

pulda.prior_semantics: population pi is the fixed distribution-alignment target.
notes: The distribution-alignment recipe and architecture are benchmark adaptations.

puet.prior_semantics: population pi weights node positive mass pi*n_P,node/n_P.
notes: Each tree bootstraps nP positives and the actual U risk-pool count; positive total weight is pi and U total weight is one.
TS calibration includes copied P rows in the U risk pool.

gradpu.prior_semantics: No objective prior; class_prior exists for fit-interface compatibility.
notes: Private cnn13_no_bn is a project architecture, not the exact author architecture.
Image encoder degeneration and numerical-risk results remain deferred; memory optimizations do not resolve them.

lagam.prior_semantics: No external prior; class_prior does not enter the objective.
notes: Native OS follows the released split; requires separately budgeted clean support.
meta_update_bias=false is a weight-only variant; CNN training uses independent streamed data.

cvir.prior_semantics: unlabeled_positive_prior is the positive fraction of the actual risk pool: alpha_U in OS, pi after explicit TS calibration; the estimator rejects class_prior.
notes: Explicit opt-in adapter converts pi to the risk-pool prior: (pi*n-nL)/(n-nL) in OS and pi in calibrated TS.
The default view remains OS despite a native TS assumption and an available TS hook.

tedn.prior_semantics: Internal BBE estimates alpha_U of the supplied marginal U; rejects external class_prior.
notes: Caller asserts input_sampling=ts; no automatic OS-to-TS conversion or clean-label support.
Internal BBE/ranking estimates alpha_U and controls retention; it is not the shared prior-estimator API.

robust_pu.prior_semantics: population pi is used in nnPU pretraining; explicit OS instead requires the original U positive fraction, with no automatic estimator conversion.
notes: The post-pretraining pseudo-negative pool remains the original U.
Direct OS and calibrated TS require different prior semantics; the estimator does not convert them automatically.

split_pu.prior_semantics: population pi is used in nnPU teacher training.
notes: Uses the released JSD weight 0.7, whose direction differs from the paper equation.
Private augmentation and SimSiam paths are benchmark approximations.

vpu.prior_semantics: No external prior; fit validates but ignores class_prior in loss and initialization.
notes: Native TS marginal-risk pool uses explicit role construction, never the observed P/U ratio as pi.
Merged validation-pool risk can be recorded as a source diagnostic, not used for PA/OA selection.
